name: Dropdown Pager
description: Provides an accessible dropdown pager option for Views.
project_description: Provides an accessible dropdown-based pager option for Drupal Views. Replaces the standard full pager with a compact dropdown button that saves space while keeping full navigation (First, Previous, Next, Last). The plugin exposes a Views pager (id "dropdown", label "Paged output, dropdown pager") built on core's SqlBase, rendered through the themeable views-dropdown-pager.html.twig template and an accessible JS/CSS library. Features an optional numeric search field to jump to a page, customizable text templates for the button/page links, ARIA labelling and full keyboard navigation (WCAG-oriented). No configuration page of its own: select it per View under Pager settings. Requires Drupal 10.3+ or 11 and core Views; no other dependencies.
